task: Arcanea.ai God Mode proof-loop sprint: clarify the first-session product journey, route the homepage toward Genesis proof creation, expose the Creature Atlas, add public status and method maps, and verify the premium experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
surface: Arcanea.ai homepage, Genesis, Creature Atlas, Status, Method, navigation, footer, metadata
audience: Modern creative operators, founders, lore builders, AI-native studios, and technically ambitious users evaluating Arcanea against ChatGPT Canvas/GPTs, Claude Artifacts/Projects, Runway, and World Anvil.

direction.keep: Cinematic Arcanea world tone, premium dark interface, clear first-session proof path, rights/provenance language, and sovereign creative intelligence positioning.
direction.avoid: Abstract filler, cultic phrasing, unverifiable persistence claims, fake product screenshots, generic fantasy copy, and unlabeled placeholder art.
direction.signature: A user arrives, names a Drift, receives a Gift, sets Right Use, creates a Genesis proof packet, and can branch into Atlas, Forge, agents, and commerce.
direction.system: Homepage prompt box routes into Genesis; Genesis emits proof packets; Atlas schematics are explicitly labeled; navigation/footer expose the product graph.

asset_quality.why_premium: The sprint uses inspected in-product Arcanea surfaces and existing owned brand media rather than unreviewed generated art. Schematic visuals are labeled as schematics so users understand their role.

assetRationale: Reused existing shipped Arcanea brand media and code-rendered schematic plates. No new generated visual was accepted as final in this slice.
